podcast.title: Vaporwave Subgenre with Limited Reach
podcast.body: Slushwave is noted as an "interesting" subgenre of Vaporwave that, along with others, did not succeed in connecting with audiences beyond niche communities, highlighting Vaporwave's overall struggle to adapt to broader internet trends compared to Phonk. "su género está en interesantes como el malls off, el utopía anvirtual o el slash wave no lograron conectar con la gente más allá de nichos."
